'''Rana Mas Square''' was a public square in [[Umbarra Plaza]] within the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The square was named after the famed [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]], and during the Cold War agents of the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] known as [[the Flame]] strung up the body of Imperial operative [[Madel Felth]]'s [[Madel Felth's agent|undercover agent]] in the square as a trap.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rana Mas Square appears as part of the Duros Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
